target.statement: PSNR of the proposed 3-frame model on the Fastec-RS dataset (30.00 dB)

compute.basis: Training the model for 150k iterations on Fastec-RS requires a GPU; on CPU it would take days, and even on a mid-range GPU it would take several hours.

blockers: Training requires a GPU (paper uses V100); CPU-only training is impractical.
Fastec-RS dataset is large (high-speed videos) and may require significant download time and disk space.
Code repository may lack training configs or pretrained models, requiring reimplementation.
title: Rolling Shutter Correction with Intermediate Distortion Flow Estimation
